title: Outlook: Expand or collapse all accounts at once
description: You'll be able to expand or collapse all accounts at once in Outlook's folder pane. You won't need to expand or collapse each account individually. This makes it easier to navigate multiple accounts or keep your folder pane compact. #newoutlookforwindows
